mechanism_narrative: The persistent week-over-week rise in RETAIL_REC from -18.0 to -10.9 reflects a reopening recovery in retail footfall that will continue, pushing the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean of -13.4.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -18.0 at t-3w to -10.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to -13.4, the recovery continuation hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility at -26.7 remains far below baseline and acts as a binding constraint on retail trips; while TRANSIT stays below -25, retail footfall will not sustain its recent rise and the next 28-day mean will fall below the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds the last 28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -25, the transit-constraint hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility above 50 indicates sustained substitution of outdoor gatherings for indoor retail activity, which will keep retail footfall depressed and push the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean below the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If PARKS remains above 50 and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than the last 28-day mean, the park-substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GROCERY_PHARM mobility at +8.0 signals renewed local shopping trips that spill over into adjacent retail and recreation visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next week and the next 28-day mean above -13.4.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays positive and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is less than or equal to -13.4, the essential-trip spillover hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery of WORKPLACES above -15 and TRANSIT above -25 signals a return of commuting flows that multiplies weekday retail footfall; their interaction will drive RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -21.4 at t-1w to -17.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES exceeds -15 and TRANSIT exceeds -25 while RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is less than or equal to -13.4, the commuting-interaction hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mobility above +2 shows that a meaningful share of activity remains home-based, suppressing retail and recreation trips; if RESIDENTIAL stays above +2, RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean will fall below the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above +2 and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than the last 28-day mean, the home-suppression hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Under the prevailing easing-restrictions regime in Victoria at the decision point, transit and workplace mobility will recover further, which in turn lifts retail and recreation visits, making the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceed -13.4.
failure_condition: If the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is less than or equal to -13.4 despite easing restrictions, the policy-reopening hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Southern-hemisphere winter conditions in June increase park visits and reduce indoor retail browsing, so elevated PARKS above 40 will coincide with a next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean below the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If PARKS remains above 40 and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than the last 28-day mean, the winter-substitution hypothesis is rejected.
